home.principlesTitle: A foundation built around real product decisions

principles.title: Technical clarity
principles.text: Structured specifications and disciplined product narratives keep engineering detail readable and comparable.

principles.title: Global by design
principles.text: Every enabled language shares one information architecture, so a specification means the same thing in every market.

principles.title: Built to evolve
principles.text: A coded template system gives each product family a distinct identity without loosening content governance.

closing.title: Tell us what the system has to do.
closing.text: Share the site conditions, load profile, and timeline. Our team will help translate them into a technical recommendation.

about.title: Engineering confidence into every energy decision.
about.intro: MAGLIVE brings product detail, technical communication, and international presentation into one disciplined experience for the people who specify, install, and operate energy systems.
paragraphs: Our work starts with the product itself: what it is made of, how it behaves across conditions, and what a project team needs to know before committing to it.
That information is then structured the same way in every language, so a specification, a datasheet, and a conversation all describe the same system.

highlights.title: Three commitments that shape every system we publish.

items.title: Documented, not described
items.text: Every claim in a product record is backed by a structured field — measurable, comparable, and consistent across the range.

items.title: Systems before components
items.text: Modules, inverters, storage, and charging are specified together, because that is how they perform in the field.

items.title: One voice, many markets
items.text: Localisation is a translation of meaning, not of layout: the same architecture, the same numbers, the same clarity.

cta.title: Bring us the requirement, not the specification.
cta.text: Our team works with project developers, EPCs, and technical buyers to match product capability to site reality.

products.title: Every product family, documented the same way.
products.intro: Solar modules, inverters, energy storage, and charging infrastructure — organised by a concise two-level taxonomy and presented with the specifications that matter for selection.
paragraphs: Each record carries its category, model, and series, so a product can be compared with the rest of the range before a datasheet is opened.
products.note: Only published, translated products appear in the catalog.

projects.title: From first survey to steady output.
projects.intro: MAGLIVE systems are delivered through a defined sequence: requirement, design, commissioning, and operating support. Each stage exists to remove a specific risk from the project.
paragraphs: Project references are published only with verified delivery data and customer approval, so nothing on this page is aspirational.

highlights.title: Four stages, each with a clear output.

items.title: Requirement
items.text: Site conditions, load profile, grid constraints, and growth plans are captured as technical inputs.

items.title: Design
items.text: Product families are combined into a system with defined performance and interface boundaries.

items.title: Commissioning
items.text: Systems are verified against the design intent before they are handed over to operation.

items.title: Operation
items.text: Documentation, service guidance, and technical support keep output predictable over time.

cta.title: Planning a site or a portfolio?
cta.text: Share the scope and constraints, and we will respond with the product combination that fits.

news.title: A clear channel for future company updates.
news.intro: Company announcements, product notes, and technical perspective from MAGLIVE, published in every enabled language.
paragraphs: Articles are published through the editorial workflow, with author attribution and structured metadata.

downloads.title: Technical documents, organized around real products.
downloads.intro: Datasheets, certificates, and brochures are attached to the product they describe, so the document you find is the document that applies.
paragraphs: Files are reusable, reference-protected, and localized where it matters — served from storage that can be replaced without breaking a link.

contact.title: Start with the right technical conversation.
contact.intro: Tell us about the site, the load, and the timeline. Enquiries are routed to the technical team best placed to answer them.
paragraphs: For product selection, include the category and model you are evaluating. For project work, include location, capacity, and target commissioning date.
